create_Game_from_json: create a Game instance by loading game state and frames from a JSON file
save_Game_to_json: save a Game object with its frames and maze data to a JSON file
create_Agent_with_pose: create an Agent with position, velocity, and computed pose based on movement state
create_Monster_with_animation: create a Monster with position, theme type, and walk animation mode logic
summarize_Frame_data: summarize a Frame object containing agent state, monsters, and coins eaten at a timestep
